comment: PKI is described as supporting biometric verification and identity credentials. PKI supports cryptographic trust but does not itself verify biometrics or establish identity correctness.

public.text: PKI is described as supporting biometric verification and identity credentials. PKI supports cryptographic trust but does not itself verify biometrics or establish identity correctness.
public.suggestedRevision: Clarify that PKI can verify credential signatures, issuer identity, and data integrity, while biometric matching and identity-proofing services provide separate functions.
